items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: Bill Russell speaking. We're having an interview with Mr. Worthy Thomas

ctx.x: I'll start off with saying this is Bill Russell speaking. We're having an interview with Mr. Worthy Thomas up at his home at 2316 Washington and the date is December 11th, 1961. Do you mind giving your full name and tell how you got your nickname of showboy too? Well my full name is

Worthy G Thomas. That G stands for George. Worthy of George Thomas and I got the name of showboy. Back in the 20s I was a good show drummer. I played drum 17 years. Were you traveling in those days? I was traveling different carnival shows and by being a good show drummer everybody started
